notes.title: Welcome To The Neon Sea
notes.content:
Frolic Labs is bringing back the nostalgia of 80’s synthwave with new music and missions on Steam!
[Check out Dune Sea on the Switch]

Toronto, Canada, November 24th, 2020 - Canadian developers, Frolic Labs, return players to their side-scrolling adventure game, Dune Sea with three all-new, all-neon, handcrafted levels. Available today on Steam, the new Neon Sea DLC is included free to all Dune Sea owners. These new Neon Sea levels made their debut this summer when Dune Sea launched on Switch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/2440c889abb63b695f35fa438edbc9af289a1284.gif

In Dune Sea, you’ll guide a migrating bird through twelve beautifully crafted landscapes while collecting items and avoiding predators on your journey home. Completing the story unlocks the new Neon Sea DLC which teleports the goose to a parallel dimension with Tron-like neon aesthetics and matching synthwave tracks.
[previewyoutube=7LPOCIOkfCg;full][/previewyoutube]
-
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/0fc21414c9ebb8e208c2d24f9fdb4f52f3455359.gif
Dune Sea is available now on the Nintendo eShop and Steam for $9.99 USD.

notes.title: Dune Sea out on Switch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/76fee37cc2f7abd82f5ecfaae25a5c31519e324c.png
The canada goose game that lets you fly like a bird debuts on Nintendo Switch with all content and features from the PC edition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/1fd309f4dd6610bef201f5e3eb3b592f906a1252.png

Wait, What?
Our team have been working for the last few months to bring Dune Sea to the Nintendo Switch. We updated it to run optimally on the Switch on all modes (Handheld, TV and Tabletop) and take full advantage of the console capabilities.

When is it Available?
Right now!  the game is available in all major markets.
Get it now on the Nintendo eShop .

[previewyoutube=WZTg4TVlIG4;full][/previewyoutube]

Bonus Content
There is indeed some fresh new content, exclusive for the Nintendo Switch.
The Switch edition contains the exclusive pack 'Neon Sea' - containing three additional chapters filled with special retro themed content.

[previewyoutube=UQ2sePswTO0;full][/previewyoutube]

---
if you are lucky enough to own a Nintendo Switch these days, go and get yourself a copy of Dune Sea from the Nintendo eShop .

---

notes.title: Flap and Chill
notes.content:
Hey Goose Players!

We know how important is to keep busy during these trying times, so here are a few reminders as to why Dune Sea is worthy of your time.

Introducing Zen Mode
This update we introduce a long time asked for feature: Zen mode.
Many players asked for it, and we have listened. This update we finally introduce Zen mode, and it is available right now.

So what exactly is Zen mode? 

In Zen mode the player become invincible and have infinite energy. You can bump into anything and just keep going. Explore all the different levels of Dune Sea with ease. Flap and Honk all the way to victory with Zen Mode!

For those who prefer challenge, keep playing Classic mode and develop your flying skills.
Note: you can switch modes at any time from the in-game pause menu.

[previewyoutube=_4Y0Vg_9fi8;full][/previewyoutube]

Huge Promo!
We want to make our game more easily accessible. To celebrate the new update, we are making Dune Sea 50% off until March 31!
This is your opportunity to show support for a small indie developer - go and get yourself a copy of Dune Sea now!

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
Our team is constantly monitoring issues and for looking for ways to improve player experience. This update includes several bug fixes improvements mostly related to gameplay. 

This includes:

 Bird alignment when landing
 Fix for player 'drift' that forced restart
 Exit from roll or dive 


We also added a game guide for new players! 
Be sure to check it out here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1973554448

notes.title: Dune Sea Localization is Live
notes.content:
We Speak Your Language!

Our team has been working on localizing the game use interface and translating all game contents. The latest patch brings the long waited international release, together with more bug fixes and enhancements. 

We are happy to inform that Dune Sea is now localized in 11 different languages, so you can enjoy playing Dune Sea in your native language. 
See full list of languages on the game store page.

Other fixes include:

 Full Steam Cloud Support
 Easier menu navigation
 Improved Landing mechanics
 Geysers will show puffs of steam just before erupting


To welcome our international fans, Dune Sea will be on Sale: 25% off for the next 7 days. 

Full release notes are available on the web page here:
https://dunesea.netlify.com/notes

notes.title: Major Patch: Flight Upgrade and Smooth Glide
notes.content:
Great news!

The team has been hard at work fixing bugs and delivering a major upgrade of the flight system.
This upgrade is focused on making the flight more responsive and improve on air maneuverability. This results in precise controls,  nimble movement and tight response for better and easier navigation.

Another exciting feature is the fly / glide mechanics: start gliding by gaining speed and then releasing the flap button. Gliding offers better control over speed by combining direction (stick / directional keys) forwards and/or up / down. Gain speed with downward glide and slow down by pulling up - until you start falling again.


Gliding takes some skill to master, so be sure to try it out.
----

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/5360502e394135da103a5badadf94b62d4a284f9.jpg
Dune Sea is Out Today!
The game has launched and is now available on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/45ef9dcfc0b4c1048e96dc3d458e795834abdd05.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/97782a0ddb402182e535e2f30b8417687ff23552.png
The Game features a Goose protagonist flying over 12 individually handcrafted levels. Each level has it's own original music track, composed by Jake Butineau, creating a unique atmospheric experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354714/bc9f24632264a7cc089dcf24f2d8241644d1f62e.png

Other than the Goose, Dune Sea is populated with beautiful birds. Over time, the player will gain the ability to perform exciting aerial stunts, fly at different speeds, bank steep turns, and smoothly glide through feature-rich, detailed character animations.
